PUNCHCONSTRUCT_ADAPTED_LARGE_CAPSULE.des: Obtain [blue]{Relics}[/blue] random [gold]Relics[/gold]. Additionally add [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Small Waves[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_ADAPTED_DINGY_RUG.descrip: [gold]Colorless cards[/gold] are much more likely to appear in card rewards.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_ADAPTED_STRIKE_DUMMY.desc: Cards with "Wave" in their name deal 3 additional damage.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_ADAPTED_FAKE_STRIKE_DUMMY: Cards with "Wave" in their name deal 1 additional damage.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_ADAPTED_RIPPLE_BASIN.desc: If you played an Attack this turn, gain 4 [gold]Block[/gold] at the end of your turn.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_ADAPTED_NUTRITIOUS_SOUP.d: On pickup, [gold]Transform[/gold] all [gold]Small Waves[/gold] in your [gold]deck[/gold] into [gold]Iron Waves[/gold] and give them [gold]Eternal[/gold].
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_ADAPTED_RUINED_HELMET.des: The first time you gain [gold]Strength[/gold] or [gold]Dexterity[/gold] each combat, gain an equal amount of the other. Triggers once per combat.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_ADAPTED_HELICAL_DART.desc: Whenever you play an Attack, gain 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_ADAPTED_LEAFY_POULTICE.de: On pickup, lose [red]{MaxHp}[/red] Max HP and [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] of your [gold]Small Waves[/gold].
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_ADAPTED_SEA_GLASS.descrip: Look at [blue]5[/blue] cards from The Regent, The Necrobinder, and The Defect each, [blue]15[/blue] total. Choose any number of them to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_ADAPTED_PRISMATIC_GEM.des: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Combat card rewards no longer contain [gold]Colorless cards[/gold].
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_ADAPTED_ARCHAIC_TOOTH.des: [gold]Transform[/gold] an [gold]Iron Wave[/gold] into [gold]Scorching Iron Wave[/gold] and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it 3 times.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_ADAPTED_PANDORAS_BOX.desc: On pickup, [gold]Transform[/gold] all transformable [gold]Small Waves[/gold], [gold]Strikes[/gold], and [gold]Defends[/gold] into other cards.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_ADAPTED_PAELS_CLAW.descri: On pickup, enchant all unenchanted [gold]Small Waves[/gold] with [purple]Goopy[/purple].
